subject: [GSoC-R] Mentors: do you need a project mailing list?

messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: [GSoC-R] Mentors: do you need a project mailing list?
parts:
Mentors:

May 4th accepted student proposals will be announced.

We have a facility on R-Forge to set up gsoc-projectname email lists.

If you would like such a list set up for your (anticipated) project,
please reply to me off-list. I'll set up the list this week and add
all the mentors, as well as any other observers or collaborators that
you designate, and then I'll add the student after the Google
announcement. In cases where a project list exists from previous
years, I'll add new mentors to the existing list.

These project-specific lists have been very useful in the past,
especially when there are more than two mentors, or there is a larger
package team that needs to be kept in the loop of a GSoC project.

Please let me know so I can get things set up before the Google
Announcement on Thursday.

Regards,

Brian
